__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Your Grafana Cloud hosted Prometheus data source

panels.description: Time since the last successful shallow ingest. Every downstream artifact — ledger rows, CLV snapshots, exit diffs, webhooks — accrues only when ingest runs. SignalsStale fires at 3h.
panels.title: Signal freshness

panels.description: 1 while a run is in flight. PipelineStalled is gated on this.
panels.title: Pipeline running

panels.description: Settled bets available to the skill fit. This sat at 0 for six weeks in 2026-07 while every process metric looked healthy.
panels.title: Resolved bets

panels.description: Fraction of wallets with skill_likelihood > 0.999. Healthy is ~1%. It hit 100% during the 2026-07-14 Newton divergence, at which point the score carried no information at all.
panels.title: Skill saturation

panels.description: Labelled by route template, never raw path — a wallet address in a label would mint one series per wallet.
panels.title: Request rate by route

panels.description: ApiErrorRateHigh fires when the 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 10m.
panels.title: Error ratio

panels.description: FeedLatencyHigh watches /signals/skilled-bets specifically at 30s.
panels.title: Request latency p99 by route

panels.description: memory = lru_cache, disk = the spill artifact, compute = a full walk of the activity file. Only compute can take >900s, so which layer is serving is the difference between a fast feed and a timeout.
panels.title: Feed serving — where results came from

panels.description: Derived from the progress callbacks the pipeline already emits; the final stage is closed by track_run on exit.
panels.title: Stage duration p95

panels.description: Sampled at the end of each stage. In 2026-07 this reached 18 GB on a 15.7 GB box and the run swap-thrashed for 13.5h without an error. PipelineMemoryHighWater warns at 8 GB.
panels.title: Stage RSS high-water

panels.description: The stall detector. Every stage transition and every persisted activity page stamps the underlying gauge, so a run in flight that flatlines here is wedged rather than slow.
panels.title: Time since last progress

panels.description: Runs per hour by shallow/deep and success/failure. PipelineRunsFailing fires on more than 2 failures in an hour. A failure here means the run produced no data, so the downstream artifacts silently did not accrue.
panels.title: Pipeline run outcomes

panels.description: Retry pressure by cause. Sustained rate_limited means POLYMARKET_API_RPS is set too high for what upstream tolerates.
panels.title: Upstream retries

panels.description: Durable write throughput — the same signal the stall detector keys on, as a rate.
panels.title: Records written

panels.description: The panel that makes the 2026-07-10 failure legible. An unbounded cookie jar pushed request BUILD time to minutes while transport stayed fast; a single round-trip timer averages the two together and shows only 'requests got slow'. Build should sit in the microseconds.
panels.title: Request construction vs transport (p99)

panels.description: Sampled BEFORE the per-response clear, so it reports what the response actually set. Sustained growth means the clear regressed. HttpClientCookieJarGrowing warns at 50.
panels.title: Cookie jar size

panels.description: UpstreamErrorRateHigh watches server_error + transport_error above 20% per host.
panels.title: Upstream outcomes by host

panels.description: Ingest is bound by a shared 5 rps upstream budget, not by CPU. When this climbs, workers are queued behind that budget — adding workers cannot help and risks upstream rate limiting.
panels.title: Rate-limiter wait

panels.description: A fitted hyperparameter fed back into the same fitter is a feedback loop. These reached mu=67.6, sigma2=1.07e7 in 2026-07 — mu=67 log-odds is a ~1e29 odds ratio, logged every run, alerted on never. PopulationPriorOutOfDomain bounds them at |mu|>5 and sigma2>4.
panels.title: Empirical-Bayes population prior

panels.description: EnrichmentProducesNoResolvedBets fires on resolved_bets == 0 while wallets > 0 — the wallets>0 conjunct is what keeps it from firing on a fresh deploy.
panels.title: Scored population
